## Judged (undeclared-conflict sweep)

- **judged-spike-resolves-attribution-dropped-at-instantiation** [UNDISPOSITIONED]: Story dc-2 commits the scaffold to writing implements edges to the parent's acceptance criteria and 'nothing else into the link graph', but parent dc-2/dc-4 establish spike-flagged stubs that carry resolves: [oq-ids] and no acceptance_criteria. When a spike stub instantiates, its graduated open-question attribution has no sanctioned path into the instantiated spec — the resolves ids stay behind in the registry entry and the scaffold is forbidden from expressing them as links — silently dropping the attribution parent dc-2 went out of its way to preserve, with no supersedes/exempts edge declared against the parent decision. (confidence 0.45)
